Mobile Methodology.description: Mobile application penetration testing methodology covering Android and iOS — static analysis, dynamic analysis, network testing, and storage inspection.

steps.task: Set up Android emulator or rooted test device (AVD or physical Pixel)
Install Frida server on device — push and run as root
Configure BurpSuite as proxy — set device proxy, install CA cert
Extract APK — adb pull or APK downloader (APKPure, gplaycli)
Install app on test device — adb install {app.apk}
Decompile APK — apktool d {app.apk} (smali/resources)
Decompile to Java — jadx-gui {app.apk}
Review AndroidManifest.xml — permissions, exported activities, backup flag
Check for hardcoded secrets — grep -r 'api_key\|password\|secret\|token' ./decompiled/
Check network security config — allow cleartext? Certificate pinning?
Identify insecure data storage — SharedPreferences, SQLite, external storage
Run automated scan with MobSF — mobsf static analysis
Check for exported components — activities, providers, receivers, services
Capture API traffic in Burp — use certificate pinning bypass if needed
Bypass certificate pinning with Frida — frida -U -f {package} -l cert_bypass.js
Use objection for runtime analysis — objection -g {package} explore
Check filesystem during runtime — adb shell ls /data/data/{package}/
Test exported activities for access control bypass — adb shell am start -n {package}/{activity}
Check logcat for sensitive data leakage — adb logcat | grep {package}
Test deeplinks and intent handling for injection
Deep link / URI scheme attack — enumerate custom scheme handlers in manifest; test parameter injection: adb shell am start -d 'myapp://action?param=<payload>'; test OAuth redirect URI hijacking
Fragment injection in exported Activities — use adb am start with extra data to load arbitrary fragments or bypass authentication screens
Test all API endpoints via Burp — auth, IDOR, injection
Test for insecure HTTP in any API call
Check if API keys in requests are reusable outside the app
Test OAuth flows — PKCE, state parameter, redirect URI validation
Check for sensitive data in HTTP headers (auth tokens in logs)
Check SharedPreferences for sensitive data — adb shell cat /data/data/{package}/shared_prefs/*.xml
Check SQLite databases — adb shell sqlite3 /data/data/{package}/databases/*.db .dump
Check external storage — /sdcard/{package}/ for sensitive files
Check if encryption keys are hardcoded or derived insecurely
Check backup flag in manifest — adb backup {package} && abe unpack backup.ab
ADB backup abuse (allowBackup=true) — adb backup -apk -f backup.ab {package}; extract with Android Backup Extractor: java -jar abe.jar unpack backup.ab backup.tar; inspect for tokens, creds, db files
Content Provider testing — enumerate exported providers; test for SQL injection via URI: content query --uri content://{authority}/table --where "1=1--"; test path traversal in file providers
Use jailbroken device (Checkra1n, Palera1n) or use Corellium for cloud device
Install Frida via Cydia/Sileo on jailbroken device
Configure BurpSuite proxy — set device proxy, install cert via Settings > VPN & Device Management
Extract IPA — sideloadly/AltStore for non-jailbroken, or pull from jailbroken device
Decrypt IPA if needed — frida-ios-dump or clutch on jailbroken device
Inspect IPA structure — unzip {app.ipa} and examine Payload/{app}.app/
Check Info.plist — permissions, URL schemes, App Transport Security (ATS)
Disassemble binary — Hopper, Ghidra, or radare2 on binary
Strings analysis — strings {binary} | grep -i 'key\|pass\|secret\|token'
Run automated scan with MobSF — iOS static analysis
Check for ATS exceptions — NSAllowsArbitraryLoads in Info.plist
Bypass certificate pinning — SSL Kill Switch 2 or Frida ssl pinning bypass script
Use objection for runtime analysis — objection -g {bundle_id} explore
Hook methods with Frida — trace classes, intercept return values, bypass auth
Check Keychain — objection: ios keychain dump
Check NSUserDefaults — objection: ios nsuserdefaults get
Check plist files in app sandbox for sensitive data
Test URL scheme handling for open redirect or injection
Intercept all API traffic in Burp after pinning bypass
Test authentication — token reuse, logout invalidation, session fixation
Test for IDOR in all resource-specific API endpoints
Check for sensitive data in HTTP headers and URL parameters
